annotationRationale: The method applies the rectangle area formula to identify the first shortening and calculate the alternative area.
sourceMethod: Follows the official comparison of the 3 by 6 card with the alternative 4 by 5 card.

review.mathCheck: The original area is 24 square inches. Reducing the 4-inch dimension removes 6 square inches, giving the stated 18. Reducing the other dimension instead gives 4 × 5 = 20 square inches, choice E. Both possible dimension changes are resolved.
review.sourceMethodCheck: Faithful rewording of supplied MAA solution #2: identify the 3 × 6 card, then calculate the alternative 4 × 5 area. The student can reconstruct the method directly.
review.annotationCheck: Bank key E, sourceQuestionId, dimensions, and square-inch units agree with the official page. No figure is needed.
